title: How to Make Money Fast in GTA 6: One Vault Pays $205,000 💰 #Shorts
description:
The biggest payday in GTA 6's story: 8 large bank vaults that pay up to $205,000 each, unlocked in Chapter 4 after the optional mission "That's Where The Money Is…". Before that: Randy's Wish List of 22 cars in Chapter 3 (upward of $30,000 per car), jewelry store jobs ($10,000 to $25,000+), and Pilot Pete's delivery flights in Chapter 4 ($10,000 to $20,000, Jason only).

Source: GTABase, "How to Make Money Fast in GTA 6: 8 Best Methods", Nov 20, 2026.
